result.instructions: Tools for Burst SMS, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Send an SMS to 61412345678 saying the order has shipped."; "Show me the SMS messages that failed to deliver today."; "List the inbound SMS replies from the last 24 hours.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Burst SMS data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run burstsms_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run burstsms_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run burstsms_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. burstsms_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: burstsms_list_sms
tools.title: List SMS messages
tools.description: List sent and received SMS messages with delivery status. Filter by date range, sender, recipient, message_ref, or direction. Returns smses, total_records and total_segments.

start_date.description: Created on or after this time (RFC 3339, for example 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z).

end_date.description: Created on or before this time (RFC 3339).

sender.description: Filter by sender number or ID.

direction.description: IN for inbound replies, OUT for sent messages.

tools.name: burstsms_get_sms
tools.title: Get an SMS message
tools.description: Get one SMS message by its id: recipient, sender, status, segment count and timestamps.

id.description: Unique id returned by Burst SMS (UUID).

tools.name: burstsms_send_sms
tools.title: Send an SMS
tools.description: Send one SMS to one recipient. This sends a real message that costs account credit and is not reversed. Long messages are split into segments. Add [opt-out-link] in the text to add an opt-out link.

sender.description: Sender number or alphanumeric sender ID shown on the handset. Must be one your account is allowed to use.

recipient.description: Destination number, local or international format (for example 61412345678).

message.description: Message body. Long text is split into several SMS segments.

message_ref.description: Your own reference, returned in webhooks so you can match events to messages.

track_links.description: Replace links in the text with tracked short links.

tools.name: burstsms_send_mms
tools.title: Send an MMS
tools.description: Send one MMS with one or more media files (https URLs of jpg, gif, png, mp3 or mp4). This sends a real message that costs account credit and is not reversed.

sender.description: Sender number or alphanumeric sender ID shown on the handset. Must be one your account is allowed to use.

recipient.description: Destination number, local or international format (for example 61412345678).

content_urls.description: Absolute https URLs of the media files.

subject.description: Subject line, up to 20 ASCII characters.

message_ref.description: Your own reference, returned in webhooks so you can match events to messages.

track_links.description: Replace links in the text with tracked short links.

tools.name: burstsms_get_mms
tools.title: Get an MMS message
tools.description: Get one MMS message by its id: recipient, sender, status and timestamps.

id.description: Unique id returned by Burst SMS (UUID).

tools.name: burstsms_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks configured on the account. An account can have at most 25.

tools.name: burstsms_get_webhook
tools.title: Get a webhook
tools.description: Get one webhook by its id: name, URL, filter and rate limit.

id.description: Unique id returned by Burst SMS (UUID).

tools.name: burstsms_create_webhook
tools.title: Create a webhook
tools.description: Create a webhook that sends JSON events (for example SMS_STATUS or SMS_INBOUND) to an https URL you control. Event data includes phone numbers and message text. An account can have at most 25 webhooks.

url.description: Absolute https URL that accepts JSON POST requests.

sender.description: Only send events for this sender.

message_ref.description: Only send events for this message_ref.

tools.name: burstsms_delete_webhook
tools.title: Delete a webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook by its id. Events stop at once; this cannot be undone.

id.description: Unique id returned by Burst SMS (UUID).
